title: Kaelen node declaration, contract version 1
description: What one capability of one node installs. Written by the node's author; the single definition of contract version 1 (specs/014-declaration-contract).

contract.description: Contract major version this declaration is written for.

targets.description: Every assistant target the capability supports. Never inferred.

governs.description: Producer directories whose every file must be declared by some item.

settings_file.description: Host-relative file where the node's settings live; the engine writes non-secret defaults there and never a value the operator set (specs/017).

signer.description: The SSH principal that signs this capability's packages; never a key. Hosts verify the signature against their trusted signers (specs/028).

runtime.description: The capability's environment, built by the engine inside the host at install (specs/022).

previous.description: Locations an earlier installation of this capability left on hosts, by another installer: adopted when the capability installs them now, retired otherwise (specs/024).

requires.description: Capabilities that must be installed on the host first: checked at install and update, never installed by the engine (specs/029).

groups.description: Named sets of items the operator chooses with --with / --without; items in no group are always installed (specs/029).

source.description: Where the operator gets it; shown as is, never run.

default.description: Chosen when the operator names no group; true when absent.

path.description: Producer-relative path: forward slashes, no empty segment, no trailing slash.

target.description: An assistant target known to the placement rule. The values are injected from kaelen/placement/rule.json when the schema is loaded: the rule is the only list of targets (specs/016-placement-rule).

targets.description: Restricts the item to some of the declared targets.

entry.description: An mcp-server item started from one of the runtime's entry points (specs/022).

runtime.description: A hook item whose script runs with the runtime's interpreter (specs/022).

file.description: A git-lines item: the git file it writes a section into (specs/025).

directory.description: A git-lines item: the host directory holding the file; the root when absent (specs/025).

lines.description: A git-lines item: the lines of its section, in order (specs/025).

allOf.description: A git-lines item belongs to the host, not to an assistant: no source, no targets (specs/025 R-1).
An engine item has no source: its content is the engine the package carries (specs/018 R-1); a git-lines item carries its lines (specs/025). Every other kind names its source.

language.description: Closed set; a later language is added without changing these.

python.description: Accepted interpreter versions: comma-separated specifiers such as >=3.11.

lock.description: Producer path of a requirements file: every requirement pinned with == and hashed.

code.description: Producer directory of the capability's own code, put on the environment's path.

path.description: Host-relative path the earlier installer wrote.

member.description: Dotted path of a member inside a shared JSON file at path, e.g. mcpServers.name.

digests.description: Digests of the contents earlier versions left there, as the engine reports them (digest_found).

setting.description: Configuration the host operator supplies. A non-secret setting may carry a default the engine installs; a secret one never carries a value. Unstated secret means secret.
